notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
-Fixed a bug where planes would sometimes immediately stop on a carrier landing
-Fixed a bug where selected starting upgrades would be improperly applied on a reset.

notes.title: Special Upgrades
notes.content:
[h2]UPDATE NOTES:[/h2]
-Added 4 special upgrades, which can be purchased for 10,000 points each
-Added a refund button in the upgrade menu
-Added 5 new achievements/liveries
-Bug fixes

tags.feature: -Added 4 special upgrades, which can be purchased for 10,000 points each

notes.title: Angry Pumpkins
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
-Number of pumpkins reduced to 2
-Pumpkins now track
-Changed Halloween colors to normal
-No height limit in Halloween
-Max extra lives reduced to 3
-Achievements for extra lives changed accordingly

notes.title: Halloween Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
-Halloween mode now consistently activates when you fly past the carrier twice
-You keep extra lives in Halloween mode
-2 new Halloween achievements
-2 new Halloween liveries

tags.feature: -Halloween mode now consistently activates when you fly past the carrier twice
-You keep extra lives in Halloween mode

notes.title: Update - Permanent Upgrades
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
-Added points, which come from your score but are cumulative
-Added permanent upgrades, which can be purchased with points
-Carrier now sails forward
-Moved mute button to bottom right corner
-More of the UI becomes green at night
-Added liveries/achievements for permanent upgrades
-Selected liveries persist between game sessions
-Added 'f2' to view hitboxes in multiplayer
-Minor bug fixes
-Minor refactoring

[h1]Texture Changes[/h1]
-Particle effects now run on delta time (mostly)
-At night, lights now change to match your plane
-Damage textures have been changed
-'Ghost' texture now has wings

[h1]Halloween[/h1]
-Added Halloween event from 10/28 to 11/1
-Added Halloween achievement/livery

notes.title: Update - HUD
notes.content:
Update Notes:
-Added more information about locked liveries
-Added stars to night mode
-UI becomes green in night mode
-Added HUD with velocity, angle, stall, and altitude information
-All achievements now unlock a livery
-Added notification when a new livery is unlocked
-Livery menu is now titled "Hangar"
-Changed camera following
-Crashed planes now move with the carrier
-Added 'F1' to disable UI

Coming Soon:
-More achievements
-More liveries
-Leaderboards in the Steam community tab

notes.content:

notes.title: Update - Liveries
notes.content:
Update Notes:
-Added 18 new liveries (skins) which can be unlocked through achievements
-Added 6 new achievements
-Added livery selection menu on the main menu
-Added a visible mute button
-Added help tips on the main menu
-Refactored menu selection
-Created discussion post for recommendations/questions

Known Bugs:
-Connecting a controller after launch causes the game to crash. This does not apply to controllers that are connected and then disconnected.

Coming Soon:
-More liveries
-More achievements
-Notification when liveries are unlocked
-Flight HUD with more information
-High score leaderboards in the community tab

notes.content:
Almost every texture, from the aircraft carrier and the planes to the ground and the waves, has been replaced with newer, more visually cohesive textures!
A few bugs have also been fixed.
